articles.translatedExcerpt: In 2026, Yutori has been on tour <Bless you!>, including her first overseas performances in Taipei, Taiwan, and Seoul, South Korea, with the mini-album ``Kokoro no Bienetsu'' released in March. After finishing the tour in June, it's time to move on to the next step... and a new song has already arrived. "Hijiri" was released on August 26th and has already become an indispensable song at live performances, and "Voice" was released on October 10th as the ending theme for the TV anime "Vermilion Mask". ``Secret'' is a guitar rock tune that they themselves created by confronting their ``yutori-ness'' once again, and ``Voice'', which is close to the anime but reveals their inner feelings as songwriters.
